hints.title: Bit Inversion Reduction
hints.text: A subarray can be reduced to all zeros if and only if every bit position appears an even number of times, meaning its bitwise prefix difference is 0.

hints.title: Prefix Bit Masking
hints.text: Compute running bitwise cumulative values using prefix states.

hints.title: Identical Prefix Pairing
hints.text: Whenever two prefix cumulative bitwise values match, the subarray between them has an even count of each bit and evaluates to zero.

hints.title: Prefix Frequency Hash Map Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def beautifulSubarrays(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        from collections import defaultdict
        count = defaultdict(int)
        count[0] = 1
        pref = 0
        ans = 0
        for x in nums:
            pref ^= x
            ans += count[pref]
            count[pref] += 1
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Single pass accumulating prefix values and querying frequencies.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all subarray ranges takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) frequency map for prefix bit states.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maps zero-reduction to prefix cumulative equality.
